A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(s)

1.  Recommendation to conduct a public hearing and adopt Resolution No. 018­2025, authorizing the
  recording of liens against various real properties in the City of Hawaiian Gardens for delinquent
  rubbish collection charges due to Waste Resources, Inc.

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, presented the staff report.

  Mayor De Paula closed the Public Hearing.

  A motion was made by Councilmember Farfan, seconded by Councilmember Roa, to approve
  recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 018­2025.

  The motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES: 5; Farfan, Roa, Vargas, Del Rio, De Paula
  NOES: 0;
  ABSENT: 0;
  RECUSE: 0;

  Motion carried: 5–0–0–0

D.  NEW BUSINESS

Mayor De Paula requested an item be added at the next City Council meeting to discuss immigration­
related resources for residents impacted by ICE challenges.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that we will hold our National Night Out event on
August 5, 2025.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on the recent Street Improvement Project.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, provided an update on staffing changes with the Sheriff’s Department,
and introduced Sergeant Michael Bitolas.

Carranza.
